source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Equipment needed only during the initial 24 hours after placement","B":"No specific equipment beyond what is used for any other client","C":"An extra tracheostomy tube of the same size (and one size smaller), suction equipment, and a resuscitation bag","D":"Only standard oxygen tubing, with no other specialized equipment kept at the bedside"}}
source_row.rationale: Bedside emergency equipment for a tracheostomy client should include an extra tracheostomy tube of the same size (and one size smaller), suction equipment, and a resuscitation bag, throughout the client's care.
source_row.stem: A nurse ensures specific emergency equipment is available at the bedside of a client with a tracheostomy. This should include:
